timeline.text: Every card and scene on my kids' TV wall looked the same — dark, thin lines, tiny type, with no safe way to try something brighter.
So I built a second React renderer that runs side by side with the original, instead of replacing it.
One switch flips the whole wall bright, or just one child's — same lessons, same timing, different skin.
Before shipping it, I checked every existing card against the original, pixel for pixel: all 430.
